name: mymultisig
description: Create, inspect, propose, review, sign and execute MyMultiSig multi-signature wallet transactions. Bundles the mymultisig-mcp server and workflow skills.

api_key.title: MyMultiSig API key
api_key.description: Optional mms_… key from https://mymultisig.app/settings/agents. Lets the agent list your wallets and queue requests as you.

private_key.title: Agent owner private key
private_key.description: Optional. The agent's own owner key (0x + 64 hex), used locally to sign approvals, execute and deploy. Never sent to any server. Use a dedicated key added as an owner, not your main wallet.

chains.title: Allowed chain ids
chains.description: Optional comma-separated chain id allowlist, e.g. 11155111. Empty allows every supported chain.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Expose read tools only, even when a private key is set.
